name: catalog_price_overrides
description: The price of one record's MONEY field for one branch of a company catalog, replacing the base price there.
lifecycle: Set, changed or removed one branch at a time with the record's observed version, which each change bumps; deleted with the record.

columns.Meaning: Company that owns the catalog (tenant key).
Catalog of the record, kept for per-catalog and per-field lookups; the module keeps it equal to the record's catalog.
MONEY field whose price is overridden.
Price in the field currency's minor units, 0 to 10^12.
columns.Unit: minor units of the field's ISO 4217 currency

columns.Meaning: PostgreSQL-clock instant of the last change.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, branch_id) REFERENCES branches(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The branch belongs to the same company.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, catalog_id) REFERENCES catalogs(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The catalog belongs to the same company.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, field_id) REFERENCES catalog_fields(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The field belongs to the same company; the module checks it belongs to the record's catalog.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, record_id) REFERENCES catalog_records(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE CASCADE
constraints.Purpose: The record belongs to the same company; overrides are deleted with it.
One override per record, field and branch.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX catalog_price_overrides_branch_idx ON public.catalog_price_overrides USING btree (company_id, branch_id)
CREATE INDEX catalog_price_overrides_field_idx ON public.catalog_price_overrides USING btree (company_id, catalog_id, field_id)
constraints.Purpose: Finds the overrides of a field for schema checks.
